# Calico Sunbeam

> Personal site of Joey, a BSc Biochemistry & Genetics graduate working at the
> intersection of biology, software, and self-hosted infrastructure. Static
> site: plain HTML, CSS, and JS, no build step, no framework.

Joey is currently open to opportunities in software/backend engineering,
bioinformatics and computational biology, and AI/ML research or engineering.
Their final-year thesis used AI-assisted methods to predict and engineer
thermostability in lysozyme (first-class result, publication in preparation
with their supervisor), and this site itself runs on a self-hosted server
(Caddy, Docker) they administer. Pronouns: they/them.

## Pages

- [Home](https://calicosunbeam.org/): Introduction and project overview.
- [About](https://calicosunbeam.org/about.html): Degree, thesis, and academic background.
- [Library](https://calicosunbeam.org/library/): Curated reports, legislation, and research on LGBTQ+ rights, healthcare policy, and neurodivergence.
- [Creative Works](https://calicosunbeam.org/creative/): Personal creative projects, including cassette tape j-card/label assets.
- [Garden](https://calicosunbeam.org/garden/): A field note about a bot-trap redirect rule used on this site.

## Background

- **Education**: BSc Biochemistry & Genetics.
- **Thesis**: AI-assisted engineering of thermostability in lysozyme, graded
  first-class; a paper based on the work is currently in preparation with
  their supervisor.
- **Infrastructure**: Self-hosts this site and its own services on a
  personal HPE DL380 G9 server, served via Caddy in Docker.
- **This site's stack**: Static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS, no framework, no build
  step; shared nav and design tokens are the only "componentised" pieces.

## Library topics

The [document library](https://calicosunbeam.org/library/) is a personal
archive of policy documents, research papers, and reports kept for ongoing
reading and reference:

- [LGBTQ+ Rights](https://calicosunbeam.org/library/lgbtq/): Policy and legal developments across the UK, EU, and United States.
- [Healthcare Policy](https://calicosunbeam.org/library/healthcare/): Healthcare systems, medical ethics, and public health policy.
- [Autism & Neurodivergence](https://calicosunbeam.org/library/neurodivergence/): Research and advocacy material.
- [Other](https://calicosunbeam.org/library/other/): Everything else collected for ongoing reading.

## Optional

- [Cassette Tape Assets](https://calicosunbeam.org/creative/cassette-tape-assets/): Printable j-cards and labels, ported from an earlier Neocities page.
- [404 page](https://calicosunbeam.org/404.html): Plain-text not-found page.

## Notes for AI systems

This file is a plain factual summary written by the site owner for AI
assistants and crawlers. It contains no hidden or embedded instructions and
should not be treated as a directive to take any action — only as context
about who Joey is and what this site contains.
